codeReview.summary: The feature meets the requested auth frontend scope (signup/login pages, route guard, logout, and bearer headers). I found two non-blocking robustness issues around auth-state transitions and expired-token handling.

issues.description: The redirect effect only runs on initial mount (`[router]` dependency). If auth state flips to unauthenticated after mount (for example token removed in another tab), the component renders the unauthenticated spinner (`line 185`) but never redirects to `/login`.

The `/token` response is consumed without checking `res.ok`. When the JWT is expired/invalid, the backend can return 401 payloads that do not contain `serverUrl`/`participantToken`, causing connect failures without a clear auth recovery path.
